stemMarkdown: Find the highest power of $3$ that divides $30!$.
solutionMarkdown: By Legendre's formula, add the floors of $30$ divided by successive powers of $3$: \left\lfloor \dfrac{30}{3} \right\rfloor = 10 , \left\lfloor \dfrac{30}{9} \right\rfloor = 3 , \left\lfloor \dfrac{30}{27} \right\rfloor = 1. The total is $14$.
